new_today.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 3 日消息，中国台湾地区电池制造商辉能 (ProLogium) 本月 2 日宣布， 其 Gen 3.5 锂陶瓷全固态电池已于其岛内 Giga-level 工业平台量产 。 辉能的 185.4Ah 大容量电芯 实现了 381 Wh/kg 的质量能量密度、903 Wh/L 的体积能量密度 ，120℃ 真空环境放置 6hr 后 失重率低于 0.05% 。 辉能的 Logithium 电芯架构以陶瓷隔层搭配特殊材料边缘框胶，在正负极隔离之外形成额外的隔离结构，包覆电极边缘可能产生的毛刺，兼具密封与绝缘功能。 而在未来，辉能计划在 Gen 4 锂陶瓷电池中采用全无机超流体化电解质系统；进一步导入可在高温下主动钝化活性材料的主动安全机制，达到“零热失控”；强化低温性能，提升材料与制造成本竞争力，扩展应用范围。

new_today.title: Dynamic Hierarchical Interleaved Bloom Filter: An Updatable Index for Large-Scale Fast Sequence Search
new_today.title_zh: 动态分层交错布隆过滤器：用于大规模快速序列搜索的可更新索引
new_today.summary_zh: 动机：测序成本的持续下降促进了可用测序数据的指数增长，像欧洲核苷酸档案库（ENA）和序列读取档案库（SRA）这样的公共数据库已达到 PB 量级。这激励了为常见生物信息学任务开发更可扩展的工具。其中一个任务是在参考数据集中近似搜索短序列模式，如基因或读取。近年来，已经提出了各种索引数据结构用于搜索大型测序数据库。最先进的索引，分层交错布隆过滤器（HIBF），是首个索引一百万个样本的同类工具。为了对扩展的存储库有用，它必须扩展以支持动态更新。结果：在本文中，我们通过扩展 HIBF 并采用部分重建来支持高效更新，引入了一种可扩展且可更新的序列搜索索引。我们通过迭代创建索引，从超过 100 TB 的压缩读取中跨越超过 39,000 个完整人类 RNA-Seq 样本，以 100 个连续批次更新，展示了动态 HIBF 的大规模数据能力。为了与最先进的工具进行基准测试，我们评估了 5,000 个样本子集

extra.description: Motivation: A continued decrease in sequencing costs has facilitated the exponential increase in available sequencing data, with public databases like the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) and Sequence Read Archive (SRA) reaching well in the order of petabases. This has been the incentive to develop more scalable tools for common bioinformatics tasks. One such task is the approximate searching of short sequence patterns like genes or reads in reference data sets. In recent years, a variety of indexing data structures have been proposed for searching large sequencing databases. The state-of-the-art index, the Hierarchical Interleaved Bloom Filter (HIBF) was first-in-class to index one million samples. To be useful for expanding repositories, it must be extended to support dynamic updates. Results: In this paper, we introduce a scalable and updatable sequence-search index by extending the HIBF with partial rebuilding to support efficient updates. We demonstrate the Dynamic HIBF's capacity for large-scale data by iteratively creating an index from over 100 TB of compressed reads across more than 39,000 full human RNA-Seq samples, updated in consecutive batches of 100. To benchmark against state-of-the-art tools, we evaluated incremental performance on a subset of 5,000 samples sub-sampled to 1% of their original read depth. In this comparative setting, the dynamic HIBF completed the sequential insertion of all 5,000 samples within 5 hours--24 to 65 times faster than competing methods and twice as fast as the static HIBF.

dropped.title: COBRA: Cell-type-specific Orthogonal Batch effect Removal Algorithm in single cell RNA-sequencing data.
dropped.title_zh: COBRA：单细胞RNA测序数据中细胞类型特异性正交批次效应去除算法。
dropped.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）能够高分辨率分析细胞异质性，但批次效应仍是数据整合中的关键挑战。现有批次校正方法通常假设批次效应在不同细胞类型间均匀，在降维空间中操作可能导致生物信息丢失，且需要大量计算资源。这里我们介绍COBRA，一种基于线性模型的批次校正方法，显式调整细胞类型特异性批次效应。通过将批次相关参数与生物变量正交化，COBRA去除技术伪影，同时保留有意义的转录差异。当细胞类型注释不可用时，COBRA实现迭代聚类算法来估计伪细胞类型，同时考虑批次效应。COBRA保留完整基因表达矩阵，确保下游分析无缝整合。我们在模拟和真实数据集（包括2型糖尿病和COVID-19数据集）上评估了COBRA。COBRA在批次混合效率、生物组结构保留和差异表达基因检测准确性方面表现更优。COBRA可在https://github.com/wonlab-healthstat/COBRA免费获取。复

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables high-resolution profiling of cellular heterogeneity, yet batch effects remain a critical challenge in data integration. Existing batch correction methods often assume homogeneous batch effect across cell types, operate in reduced-dimensional space leading to potential loss of biological information, and require extensive computational resources. Here, we introduce COBRA, a linear model-based batch correction method that explicitly adjusts cell-type-specific batch effect. By orthogonalizing batch-associated parameters with respect to biological variables, COBRA removes technical artifacts while preserving biologically meaningful transcriptional differences. When cell type annotations are unavailable, COBRA implements an iterative clustering algorithm to estimate pseudo-cell types while accounting for batch effects. COBRA retains the full gene expression matrix, ensuring seamless integration for downstream analyses. We evaluated COBRA across simulated and real-world datasets, including type 2 diabetes and COVID-19 datasets. COBRA outperformed in terms of batch mixing efficiency, preservation of biological group structure, and accuracy of differentially expressed gene detection. COBRA is freely available at https://github.com/wonlab-healthstat/COBRA. The code to reproduce the analyses is archived at Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19891355). Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

dropped.title: Topologically-based parameter inference for agent-based model selection from spatiotemporal cellular data
dropped.title_zh: 基于拓扑的参数推断用于时空细胞数据的基于代理模型选择
dropped.summary_zh: 时空单细胞成像的进展使得详细观察细胞群体动态和细胞间相互作用成为可能。然而，将这些丰富数据集转化为机制洞察仍是重大挑战。基于代理模型（ABMs）是一种自下而上的计算框架，用于研究由单个相邻细胞间相互作用规则产生的细胞群体涌现行为，而拓扑数据分析（TDA）提供空间组织的稳健描述符。我们提出TOPAZ（基于拓扑的参数推断用于基于代理模型优化），一个将TDA与近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）、近似近似贝叶斯计算（AABC）和贝叶斯模型选择相结合的计算流程，从时空细胞数据中识别生物学合理的ABMs。TOPAZ使用持续同调量化细胞轨迹的空间特征，并通过ABC和AABC结合拓扑信息进行参数推断，使用贝叶斯信息准则进行模型比较。我们使用成纤维细胞集体运动模拟验证TOPAZ，展示其准确恢复模型参数并区分基线ABM和包含对齐相互作用的扩展模型的能力。我们的结果和开源代码展示了TOPAZ作为空间单细胞分析中机制推断和

extra.description: Advances in spatiotemporal single-cell imaging have enabled detailed observations of cell population dynamics and intercellular interactions. However, translating these rich data sets into mechanistic insight remains a significant challenge. Agent-based models (ABMs) are a bottom-up computational framework for investigating the emergent behavior of cell populations that can arise from rules defining the interactions between individual neighboring cells, while topological data analysis (TDA) provides robust descriptors of spatial organization. We present TOPAZ (TOpologically-based Parameter inference for Agent-based model optimiZation), a computational pipeline that integrates TDA with approximate Bayesian computation (ABC), approximate approximate Bayesian computation (AABC), and Bayesian model selection to identify biologically plausible ABMs from spatiotemporal cellular data. TOPAZ uses persistent homology to quantify spatial features of cell trajectories and combines this topological information with parameter inference via ABC and AABC and model comparison using the Bayesian information criterion. We validate TOPAZ using simulations of collective fibroblast movement, demonstrating its ability to accurately recover model parameters and distinguish between a baseline ABM and an extended model that incorporates an alignment interaction. Our results and open-source code demonstrate the utility of TOPAZ as an extensible framework for mechanistic inference and model discrimination in spatial single-cell analysis.
